My mom is 63 — and this is one of the ways she eats her skincare 🥕 She calls it her glow juice — the one she makes almost every morning. You only need 5 things 👇 1. 🌊 Cevitol Marine Collagen Peptides 300 Dalton marine collagen peptides — 100% pure collagen made specifically for skin, recommended by dermatologists and pharmacists. 2. 🥕 Carrots Rich in beta-carotene, which supports skin cell renewal and keeps skin looking firm. 3. 🫚 Ginger Contains anti-inflammatory compounds that help manage oxidative stress inside the skin — one of the biggest causes of skin aging. 4. 🍊 Fresh oranges Loaded with vitamin C that brightens your skin. 5. 🍋 Lemon Helps clear impurities from within your skin, leaving it looking clear and radiant. ✅ How to make it: Chop the carrots, oranges, lemon, and a small piece of ginger, and add them all to the blender. Add one scoop of Cevitol marine collagen and blend until smooth. Strain it through a fine sieve, then pour into a tall glass. One glass a day — that's all she does. ✅ Why it works Carrots support skin cell renewal and help keep your skin looking firm. Ginger contains anti-inflammatory compounds that help manage oxidative stress.  Fresh oranges and lemon are packed with vitamin C, which helps your skin look brighter and clearer. But the real magic?  The marine collagen. Cevitol uses ultra-fine 300 Dalton marine collagen peptides, designed for easy absorption.  When you nourish your skin from the inside out, it can show on your face. Always remember — true beauty starts in the kitchen 🍽️✨ #antiaging #eatingskincare #skinjuice
